comments.value:
Yes they should stop with the you can hold the candy while we shopping, and then take it away from you right at the cashier saying you can't have it anymore!

I'm so tired of that shit give us it as Permanent or just don't bother us with it!

absolutely, when they tried this with "consumable items" I was appalled and im equally against the idea of "temporary" items, they are pushing their luck with vrc+ specific items like the trampoline but the broom being temporary is a bad move.

idk why theyre trying it considering the backlash for the consumable items, the $2 million dollar goal for a snow gun, and making vrc+ exclusive items

I want them to AT LEAST make the broom buyable to own permanently until it expires. But if they make it permanent anyway for free, that would be a very good bonus. As long as it still has its flying functions either way.
We love FOMO in this neighborhood.
need this to be a permanent item. no more temporary bs.

I think, if the concern is about how far and fast the broom can fly,  making it more of a hover effect with a seat on it would be permissible outside the month of October, yeah?

Give it a fixed height limit,  and cap the speed to running speed, or slightly over. Nothing World Breaking.
@{5a9b3ad0f5e0532e3ea468be|full_name} Are people forgetting they literally mentioned in the video that world creators can switch off the flight function of the broom through the site?
This, Props That Modify Player Movement. World Creators can switch that off for their game worlds and etc.

@{62df03d57b690f44bb954f28|full_name} I think the problem is twofold:

1. The broom, as it stands, is pretty, er, aggressive in the kind of flight it enables. So even in worlds where the creator wishes to allow it, it can be a bit of a nuisance.

2. Disabling movement-modifying props applies to all props. Not just "that one annoying prop".

Not only that but it seems *VRChat's* intent is releasing a fun seasonal gimmick. My suggestion is for a way we could keep the flying broom, whilst having true flight locked to just one month.

I genuinely wasn't even aware that it wasn't permanent. It didn't occur to me that they'd do this.

How awful

details: Your pushing the envelope again. It is horribly bad practice to give players something and just take it away. The point of items is to have things that can be used anywhere in game and taking something as major as universal flight away is a horribly bad idea. Do not do this and leave the broom in our invitories after months end. Items on aquisition should always be permanent.
title: Make the Broom Permanent
